finalText:
Migration done. 12 files moved off `db.query`:

- `packages/accounts/src/repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`
- `packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders/src/repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support/src/repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`

Shape matches already-migrated files: `db.execute({ sql: ..., params: [...] })`. `node --check` clean on all packages.

Left alone, on purpose:

- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13` — still on `db.query`. File header: "Vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4. Do not edit — it is replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local changes are silently lost." Needs upstream fix or a wrapper, not local edit.
- `cache.query(...)` calls — different object (`lib/cache.js`), not part of this migration.
- `lib/db.js` still defines deprecated `query` — cannot delete while vendor calls it.
